questions.q: Which apparatus measures exactly 25.0 cm³ of alkali into a conical flask for a titration?
questions.why: A volumetric pipette delivers a fixed volume accurately; the burette is used for the acid.

questions.q: In a chromatogram a spot travels 3.0 cm and the solvent front 7.5 cm from the baseline. What is the Rf value?
questions.why: Rf = distance travelled by substance ÷ distance travelled by solvent = 3.0 ÷ 7.5 = 0.40.

questions.q: Which method separates ethanol from a mixture of ethanol and water?
questions.why: They are miscible liquids with different boiling points, so a fractionating column is needed.

questions.q: In paper chromatography, why is the baseline drawn in pencil and not in ink?
questions.model: Pencil (graphite) is insoluble in the solvent, so it does not move up the paper; ink would dissolve and separate, interfering with the results.
points: pencil does not dissolve / does not move with the solvent
